title: Learning to Coordinate: LLM-Guided Workflow Evolution for Token-Efficient Red Teaming
abstract: arXiv:2611.24221v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Automated red teaming is essential for identifying safety failures in large language models (LLMs), but its practical scalability depends on the resources required to discover those failures. Multi-agent systems can combine complementary capabilities, yet repeated planning, redundant exchanges, and ineffective information routing can make their coordination expensive. Moreover, a target model's response indicates the outcome of a test without identifying which collaboration decision should change. We present Learning to Coordinate (L2C), an LLM-guided framework that evolves an executable multi-agent workflow for each red-teaming case. L2C represents agent responsibilities, execution dependencies, and input bindings in a versioned graph, and associates each graph with records of the information actually delivered and produced. translated_title: 学会协调：基于LLM引导的工作流演化实现令牌高效的红队测试
translated_abstract: 自动化红队测试对于识别大语言模型（LLM）中的安全缺陷至关重要，但其实际可扩展性取决于发现这些缺陷所需的资源。多智能体系统能够结合互补的能力，然而重复的规划、冗余的交互以及低效的信息路由会使协调成本高昂。此外，目标模型的响应只能表明测试的结果，却无法指出应当修改哪一个协作决策。我们提出了Learning to Coordinate（L2C），这是一个由LLM引导的框架，能够为每个红队测试用例演化出可执行的多智能体工作流。L2C在版本化图中表示智能体的职责、执行依赖关系和输入绑定，并将每个图与实际传递和产生的信息记录相关联。通过监督微调训练的控制器将这些记录与目标响应、评估器验证……
tldr: 提出L2C框架，利用LLM引导的版本化图与信息流记录来演化多智能体协作工作流，并通过监督微调的控制器优化协作决策，从而实现令牌高效的大模型红队测试。
en_tdlr: L2C is an LLM-guided framework that evolves per-case executable multi-agent workflows using versioned graphs and information-flow records, enabling token-efficient red teaming of LLMs.
